fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records (S1-jsonld+html) resolve a Yoast SEO @graph JSON-LD block for metadata plus the HTML article body, so extra fields beyond those listed here may appear. Latest-mode records (S2-sitemap) carry title/link-style fields from ThePrint's Google News sitemap.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-jsonld+html or S2-sitemap).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind (not_found, not_article, http_<code>, or blocked_or_transient).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline, from the JSON-LD Article node (article mode only).

description.title: Description
description.description: Short article summary/dek, from the page's meta description (article mode only).

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description: Full plain-text article content, reconstructed from the HTML article-body container (article mode only).

author.title: Author
author.description: Byline name(s), comma-joined if multiple authors (article mode only).

articleSection.title: Section
articleSection.description: Article section/category, as emitted upstream (article mode only).

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Keyword tags, as emitted upstream -- e.g. "reuters wire" or "PTI wire" on wire-sourced pieces (article mode only).

wordCount.title: Word count
wordCount.description: Upstream-computed word count as of scrape time (article mode only).

commentCount.title: Comment count
commentCount.description: Upstream comment count as of scrape time (article mode only).

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline, from the Google News sitemap (latest mode only).

pubDate.title: Publish date
pubDate.description: ISO 8601 publish timestamp from the news sitemap (latest mode only).

image.title: Image
image.description: Lead image URL, from the news sitemap (latest mode only).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
